topic: India lose Hamilton finale, still take N
hook: India lose Hamilton finale, still take NZ T20 series *3-2*
hook_b: Seifert's *93* off 50 spoils India's series party in Hamilton
tldr: New Zealand beat India by 7 wickets in the 5th T20I, but India won the series 3-2.

beats.what: NZ won the final T20I in Hamilton on Nov 1; India had already sealed the series.
beats.why: Tim Seifert hit 93 off 50 and Glenn Phillips 65* off 38 to chase India's 191/8.
beats.care: Series in the bag; the ODIs against New Zealand come next.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: India made 191/8 around fifties from Shreyas Iyer and Ishan Kishan (61 off 32, per TOI). Kishan became the third-fastest Indian to 2,000 T20I runs by balls faced (1,345). Seifert hit 11 fours and 5 sixes. NZ reached 195/3. India made two changes: Bhuvneshwar Kumar returned and Varun Chakaravarthy played his first game of the tour.

cards.title: 🏏 Kishan milestone
cards.body: 2,000 T20I runs in 1,345 balls: third-fastest Indian by balls faced.

cards.q: Series won, finale lost. Your verdict?
Who top-scored for New Zealand in the 5th T20I?
cards.why: Seifert hit 93 off 50 balls; Phillips made 65 not out.

insight: NZ chased 192 with 195/3; Seifert and Phillips added 86 for the third wicket.
watch: India's ODI XI for the New Zealand series.
